name: South Nature and Climate Action Fund
summary: Small council grants for local not-for-profit groups and parish councils in South Oxfordshire to take climate action and support nature recovery, including habitat creation and restoration and community access to nature.

eligibility.rule: Town or parish council, parish meeting, or local not-for-profit whose main purpose benefits South Oxfordshire residents
The project completes within 12 months of the award decision
Has named officers, members, or trustees on a management committee or board
Is not a political or lobbying group
Is not a nationwide organisation unless it has a local constitution or local bank account
Is not a school, college, or university

documents: Recent bank statement in the organisation's name, no more than two months old

pool.quote: South Oxfordshire District Council has a budget of £100,000 to award to projects across South Oxfordshire

applicant_types.quote: Town/parish councils and parish meetings Local 'not for profit' organisations, (this can include a company limited by guarantee which does not distribute any surplus it makes to its members), whose primary purpose is to benefit the residents of South Oxfordshire

geography.quote: Projects must take place within the South Oxfordshire district for the benefit of South Oxfordshire residents

access.quote: Organisations apply using the council's online grants management system

amount.quote: The minimum grant you can apply for is £250 and the maximum is £10,000

window.quote: Usually, the scheme will be open for one round of applications per financial year

co_finance_required.quote: We can fund up to 100 per cent of the total cost of a project (budget permitting)

effort.quote: Organisations apply using the council's online grants management system ('the system'), accessible from the grants page of our website.
Council officers will check the eligibility of the application (including the additional checks if required) and liaise with the applicant, if necessary, to establish eligibility.

eligibility.quote: Town/parish councils and parish meetings Local 'not for profit' organisations, (this can include a company limited by guarantee which does not distribute any surplus it makes to its members), whose primary purpose is to benefit the residents of South Oxfordshire
The project must complete within 12 months of the award decision
Confirm their organisation has named officers, members, or trustees on a management committee/board.
Nationwide organisations (except where they have a local constitution and/or local bank account.
Schools, colleges, universities (please note however, eligible organisations can involve school groups and education settings in their projects)

documents.quote: Provide with their application a copy of a recent bank statement in the name of the organisation applying (no more than two months old)
